_prior_gvb_picks_superseded_b9._disposition: Phase-2 acquisition will still acquire these 5 as SECONDARY-COMPARISON (Brandon-NOT-rated-top-5; agent-perceived-transformational) — they serve as an interesting middle-tier sanity-check: if they score comparably high on ETM_v2, the agent's intuition is *partial* not zero (agent picked transformational-grade Gaither songs even if not Brandon's-specific-top-5); if they score lower, the agent's intuition is genuinely miscalibrated and the model trained on Brandon's-canonical-list has better discriminant validity.

_summary.phase_2_validation_target: Pearson r >= 0.6 between MIR-extracted aggregate and Phase-1 expert-judgment aggregate over the 10-song set; per-feature r reported for diagnostic
_summary.honest_69_brandon_canonical_lower_mean_t: Brandon-canonical GVB-5 mean (0.68) is LOWER than PMD-Sky-5 mean (0.75) — agent's per-feature estimates skew conservative for the new Brandon-canonical list pending Brandon direct re-rating. PMD-Sky estimates retain prior B6/B7 calibration.
